data.name: School Strike
data.description: You focus the secrets of your school of wizardry into your unarmed strike.

raw_tokens.value: You focus the secrets of your school of wizardry into your unarmed strike.

When you gain this feat, choose one arcane school power that you can use to affect no more than one opponent. If you make a successful unarmed strike against an opponent, in addition to dealing your unarmed strike damage, you can use a swift action to deliver the effects of the chosen school power to that opponent. Doing so provokes no attacks of opportunity. &nl; [Special]You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you take it, you apply it to a different qualifying arcane school power.
